reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is identical to the original paragraphs with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited text supports compliance: §1 engages Services per-Exhibit and expressly disclaims exclusivity or any restriction on Customer selling Inventory elsewhere, and §5 is a pure revenue share on revenue actually generated with no minimum, shortfall or take-or-pay mechanic — this meets the MINCOMMIT preferred position.
The rationale appropriately notes the §4(a) one-year term lock-in as context only rather than flagging it, since there is no committed spend and term/termination rights fall outside this rule.
